title: random
text:
random

Maya: 🎄 Ugly Mug Olympics idea — bring your ugliest holiday mug to Friday's 9am PT standup (or post a photo if you're remote). Categories: Best Mug, Best Backstory, Most Likely To Be A Family Heirloom. Prize: eternal office fame + a $25 coffee card. Who's in? :trophy:
Adam: love this. timezone check — 9am PT is noon ET, right? Can we do a quick thread for people to say if they'll post a photo instead? :coffee:
Sophia: I'm in! Will post a photo from London (that's 5pm GMT for me). Also maybe a tiny trophy emoji reaction on winners? :grin:
Jamie: count me in, but mine might be an actual broken mug taped back together. Winning strategy? 😅
Liam: i'll bring the mug with the tiny christmas tree glued to it. Also can we have a remote prize for people in other regions? small voucher works.
Olivia: putting my name here — will be remote, will post a pic. here's a super quick signup so we can judge categories: https://tinyurl.com/ugly-mug-signup (2 Qs: in-person or remote, photo link).
Maya: perfect. We'll run live voting in thread after each photo. Judges = volunteers. Volunteers? :raised_hand:
Jamie: volunteer judge. happy to give stern commentary.
Adam: volunteer judge too.
Sophia: i'll be judge for the 'most likely inherited' category.
Liam: remote prize confirmed — +1 for voucher.
deploy-bot: Reminder: Weekly all-team standup scheduled 2026-01-09 09:00 PT. Agenda: 1) quick updates 2) ugly mug reveal 3) shoutouts.
Olivia: yayyyy :partying_face: see you all Friday. Also, if anyone wants to swap mugs after, I have spare wrapping paper.
Maya: official plan posted in calendar invite. Thanks everyone — can't wait. Post your photos in this thread if you can't be live. :camera_with_flash:
